AT0098.title: Dependency Poisoning Toolkit
AT0098.description: Tools and methods for publishing malicious packages to open-source repositories (npm, PyPI, Maven, RubyGems, Go Modules). Attack techniques include: typosquatting (registering packages with names similar to popular ones); dependency confusion (exploiting priority vulnerabilities between internal and public packages); maintainer account takeover; and installation hook exploitation. Typical consequences include credential theft, reverse shells, and cryptocurrency mining.

references.title: MITRE ATT&CK: Supply Chain Compromise - Compromise Software Supply Chain (T1195.002)
